items.point: PK=COURIER#<courierId>#<yyyyMMdd> SK=<ts ms> | lat, lng, accuracy, deliveryId?, expiresAtEpoch (90 days)

accessPatterns: persist: BatchWriteItem from the courier.events consumer
dispute / replay a delivery route: Query PK=COURIER#c#day AND SK BETWEEN assignedAt AND deliveredAt
_design.why: 50k points/s is pure append, read rarely and by key; courier+day partitions stay small and evenly spread; TTL expires history without a cleanup job
